candidate.user_input: How can I volunteer to be an onboarding buddy and who is responsible for assigning buddies?
candidate.reference: Buddy assignation is the new team member's manager's responsibility as outlined in the onboarding issue. If you have been at GitLab 3+ months and are interested in participating in the Onboarding Buddy Program, please express your interest to your manager.

evidence.quote: Buddy assignation is the new team member's manager's responsibility as outlined in the [onboarding issue](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/people-group/people-operations/employment-templates/-/blob/main/.gitlab/issue_templates/onboarding.md) as the very first `Before Starting at GitLab` manager task. If you have been at GitLab 3+ months and are interested in participating in the Onboarding Buddy Program, please express your interest to your manager.
evidence.contribution: explains how to volunteer and who assigns buddies

candidate.connection: The context directly states the process for volunteering and who assigns onboarding buddies.

source_conditions: Buddy assignation is the new team member's manager's responsibility.
This is outlined in the onboarding issue as the first 'Before Starting at GitLab' manager task.
To volunteer, you must have been at GitLab 3+ months.
You must express your interest to your manager.
